scenes.title: Buying one? Check these 5 things first.
Which engine?
scenes.body: A 1KD needs its timing belt at 150,000 km. Listen for a cold-start knock.

scenes.title: Ask about regens.
scenes.body: 2015–20 diesels: look for the DPF switch and the 2020 exhaust fix.

scenes.title: Pull the air filter.
scenes.body: Dust on the clean side can coat the 2.8's MAF and cause limp mode.

scenes.title: Press the pedal.
scenes.body: Pre-2012 trucks could get a spongy or hard pedal and a booster hiss.

scenes.title: Check bushes and air.
scenes.body: Rear air springs leak with age; factory shocks are often tired by 100,000 km.
